name: Austin Casteel
subtitle: Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, and Culinary Craft - One Mind, Three Passions
bio: I'm a cybersecurity specialist, AI engineer and researcher, and passionate home chef driven by curiosity and creative problem-solving. From securing digital systems and exploring intelligent technologies to experimenting in the kitchen, I enjoy understanding complex systems, building new things, and finding better ways to solve problems. Bridging security, intelligence, and flavor - one challenge at a time.
